Create a statistical analysis plan

Source: R/analysis_plan.R
analysis_plan.Rd

Create a statistical analysis plan

Usage

analysis_plan(
  objective = c("distribution", "trend", "comparison", "interval", "control_chart"),
  response = NULL,
  censored = NULL,
  date = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  comparison = NULL,
  method = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05,
  confidence_level = 0.95,
  censoring_method = NULL,
  missing_policy = c("exclude_required_fields", "error"),
  guidance = guidance_options(),
  parameters = list()
)

Arguments

objective

Analysis objective: "distribution", "trend", "comparison", "interval", or "control_chart".

response

Name of the numeric response column.

censored

Name of the logical censoring-indicator column.

date

Optional date/time column used for trend analyses.

group

Optional grouping column.

comparison

Optional comparison column.

method

Optional pre-specified method. If NULL, the method is selected using the guidance rules.

alpha

Type I error rate.

confidence_level

Confidence level for intervals.

censoring_method

Explicit censored-data method, if required.

missing_policy

Missing-data policy.

guidance

Guidance profile returned by guidance_profile().

parameters

Additional method-specific parameters.

Value

An object of class "statistical_analysis_plan".
